questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The pleasure created by the poet was primarily **__until his exaggerated descriptions__**.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"through his exaggerated descriptions."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Until" **is used to indicate the point in time up to which an action or state continues.
 
• It implies a cutoff point and suggests that something will happen or continue up to a specific moment but not beyond it.
 
 
• **Example**: *She worked **until**__ midnight.* 
 
 
 
• **"Through"** is used to indicate a period of time during which something happens or continues.
 
• It suggests completeness, from the beginning to the end of a particular time or event.
 __
 
• **Example**:* He worked **through**__ the night.*
 
 
 
• *​*So, the word** "until"** must be replaced with "**through"** to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

**Correct sentence**: *The pleasure created by the poet was primarily __**through his exaggerated descriptions**__. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "Below"** indicates a lower position or level in relation to something else. It's used when one thing is under or underneath another.
 
• **Option 2, "Beside"** indicates a position next to or at the side of something. It implies being in close proximity or adjacency to another object or person.
 
• **Option 3, "Off" **indicates a separation or a distance from a particular point or object. It's used to describe movement away from something or being removed from a surface.
